shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
circular disc motif (plain circles in A, rosettes in B)
justification: Both are grey stone surfaces bearing relief carving that includes an anthropomorphic figure and repeated circular/disc motifs set off by horizontal incised bands, which is about as far as the correspondence goes. A is a single free-standing, heavily eroded block whose crude, shallow, schematic markings read as one vertical body, whereas B is a crisply cut, highly detailed architectural wall organised into stacked horizontal registers with a chariot, horses and a file of processing figures beneath a stepped parapet — utterly different in scale of ambition, execution and composition.
